wallet-health.getOrgsByOrgIdWalletHealth.description: The health of each wallet open to the organization in the key's mode: the last update the provider accepted, updates queued, failed in the last 24 hours and with an unknown outcome, and the provider's last report. A wallet that is not released, not in the plan or not enrolled is left out. A key needs wallet:read.

wallet-health.postOrgsByOrgIdWalletHealt.description: Sends a wallet's updates with an unknown outcome to settle, once they are past the 10 minute window; those still inside it settle by themselves. Answers how many were sent (at most 50) and how many are still waiting. A key needs passes:write; ten calls an hour per wallet.
